scope: All 302 ordinary English Unlimited nonfoil-available printings; no renderer change or whole-card scores.
policy: Paper-border registration for red, artifact, blue and green. Previously validated frame-texture registration retained for white, black and land. Selection is per material, never a per-card best-score choice. Fixed eight-card cohorts train each template. Three disjoint bands fit, select model complexity and certify. Canonical resize then one composed warp; scan poses never enter renderer inputs.
validationDisclosure: Previously inspected validation remains reused validation. Blue/green extension froze its templates after calibration and known-pose tests, before evaluating all 92 cards. Independent art edges and previously accepted texture poses are diagnostics only; neither retunes a pose.
metrics: Mean absolute boundary displacement in canonical pixels against frozen scan medians, not renderer accuracy or percent correct. Baseline confidence fixes edge eligibility on both sides.
limits: Local art-edge regressions remain explicit; boundary profiles can include illustration pixels.
Mask perturbation proves isolation from pixels outside the selected narrow bands; it is not independent proof that every pixel inside them is free of lettering.
Outer-border agreement stays separate after interior alignment. Unavailable scan coverage must not be counted as a match.
Original text/type coverage is still incomplete. Live review templates have not been changed by this study.
